Extra process runtimes are the 19.79 GiB cost; extra SLOT runtimes share weights.

Controller currently drops workspace on the floor, so Engine's store never becomes the pool's cap. Scratch apply+py_compile ok=True (compiled), applicable=applicable.

REJECTED as correctness against the unmeasured invariant. test_unmeasured_overlap_admits_one_runtime requires DEFAULT_OVERLAP_ADMIT_CAP=1: a mission that has never overlapped must not reserve a second slot (or a 19.79 GiB process). Cheap disproof already in hand: unmeasured admitted_n=1 with default_cap=1. Raising the default would make that probe admit 2 without evidence.

REJECTED on measured tok/s, not theory. A native run with two 27B model servers resident delivered 3.986 tok/s against 33.47 with one — an 8.4x collapse. This contract forbids spawning a second llama-server. PROCESS topology is how you buy that collapse. SLOT topology on the live --parallel 2 server is the only honest way to spend overlap=2.
